summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Investment SLABs and Blockchain Transactions features. All 14 backend API tests PASSED. Frontend UI tests PASSED. Investment from balance works correctly for all SLABs with proper validation. BNB shows REAL BSC blockchain transactions with valid hashes. Token transactions (DOGE, USDT, etc.) show SIMULATED but realistic live trading feed.

issues: Binance API CORS error when fetching chart data directly - fallback chart data is used instead. This is expected behavior for direct browser calls to external APIs.

critical_code_review_comments: Investment SLAB ranges correctly implemented: SLAB 1 ($1-$19, 5.5%), SLAB 2 ($20-$299, 6%), SLAB 3 ($300-$2999, 6.5%), SLAB 4 ($3000-$50000, 7%)
Balance deduction works correctly - welcome_bonus used first, then balance
BNB transactions fetch REAL data from BSC blockchain via RPC
Token transactions (DOGE, USDT, BTC, ETH) use simulated live feed due to BSC public RPC rate limits on eth_getLogs
Transaction hashes are properly formatted (0x + 64 hex chars) and verifiable on BSC explorer
seed_data_creation: Used existing test user - created 2 test investments during testing (SLAB 1: $5, SLAB 2: $25)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Investment SLABs and Blockchain Transactions fully tested. BNB shows real BSC transactions. Token transactions are SIMULATED (MOCKED) but realistic. Test user balance reduced from $37 to $7 after test investments.
